name.la: De septem verbis a Christo in cruce prolatis
name.en-US: The Seven Words Spoken by Christ on the Cross
name.pt-BR: As sete palavras de Cristo na cruz

description.la: Duo libri de septem verbis a Christo in cruce prolatis: explicatio litteralis et fructus ex singulis (1618).
description.en-US: Two books on the seven last words of Christ: the literal sense of each word and the fruits to be drawn from it (1618). The Latin is the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan; the English is the anonymous Burns & Oates translation of 1877.
description.pt-BR: Dois livros sobre as sete palavras de Cristo na cruz: o sentido literal e os frutos de cada uma (1618).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.

sources.edition: The Seven Words Spoken by Christ on the Cross (London: Burns & Oates, 1877), reprinted from the Messenger of the Sacred Heart.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt): page heads removed, lines rejoined; a few chapter-opening letters lost to drop caps and some words split at line ends remain.
